nodes.description: Private owner address set in constructor from msg.sender; used as privileged access gate in ensure, delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances, mutated in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending allowances, mutated in approve, transferFrom and constructor.
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist consulted by ensure to bypass sale restrictions.
Private mapping(address=>uint256) counting sale participations per address; incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Private minimum sale amount in wei-scaled token units, set by init, read by condition.
Private maximum sale amount, set by init, read by condition.
Private maximum number of allowed sales per address, set by init, read by condition.
Address of the whitelisted trading venue, set by setTradeAddress, read by ensure.
Public total token supply, assigned in constructor.
Public constant decimals = 18, used as exponent in init and constructor scaling.
Public token name, assigned in constructor.
Public token symbol, assigned in constructor.
Public payable transfer entrypoint that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view gate applying owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale whitelist and otherwise calling condition.
Public payable transfer logic: allowance handling, ensure() gate, balance mutations and _onSaleNum increment.
Public payable allowance setter writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-constraint checker using _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-influenced address a with data b.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum with unchecked scaling multiplications.
Owner-only batch distribution looping over _tos with unchecked total computation and balance decrement.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Internal pure Uniswap-style CREATE2 pair address computation used by ensure.
Deployer constructor minting supply, assigning owner = msg.sender and pre-approving the UNI router.
Caller-controlled address used for owner checks, allowance keys, balance targets and minting.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address supplied by the caller-permitted owner path (storage hijack risk).
Unchecked subtraction of the transferred value from the sender balance in transferFrom.
Unchecked addition of the transferred value to the recipient balance in transferFrom.
Unchecked subtraction of the spent value from the spender allowance in transferFrom.
Unchecked multiplication computing the batch total in batchSend, overflowable.
Unchecked subtraction of the batch total from the caller balance in batchSend.
Unchecked constructor multiplication scaling the initial supply.
Unchecked multiplication scaling _minSale in init.

edges.reason: transfer forwards its _to parameter into the transferFrom call.

transfer passes _value into transferFrom.

transferFrom reads the _to recipient parameter.
transferFrom reads the _value amount parameter.
msg.sender is compared with _from and used as the allowance spender key, giving the caller control over the spending path.
transferFrom calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) as its authorization gate.
transferFrom performs the unchecked sender balance subtraction.
transferFrom performs the unchecked recipient balance addition.
transferFrom performs the unchecked allowance subtraction.
balanceOf state mapping supplies the value subtracted in transferFrom.
balanceOf state mapping supplies the value added in transferFrom.
allowance mapping supplies the value decremented in transferFrom.
ensure reads the _from parameter for whitelist checks.
ensure reads the _to parameter for whitelist checks.
ensure forwards _value to condition.
ensure grants an unconditional bypass when _from or _to equals the owner address.
ensure consults the canSale whitelist mapping to bypass restrictions.
ensure consults tradeAddress as a whitelisted bypass address.
ensure calls condition for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure uses the pairFor computed UNI pair address.

approve reads the _value parameter.

condition compares _value against the _maxSale state variable.

delegate reads the target address parameter a.
delegate reads the calldata parameter b.
delegate authorizes only msg.sender == owner before executing the call.
delegate reaches the arbitrary delegatecall, letting the owner execute untrusted code in this contract's storage context.

init reads the saleNum parameter assigned to _saleNum.
init reads the token parameter used to derive _minSale.
init reads the maxToken parameter used to derive _maxSale.

init writes the _minSale state variable.
init writes the _maxSale state variable.
init writes the _saleNum state variable.

batchSend reads the _value amount parameter.

batchSend computes the total local variable.
batchSend performs the unchecked _value * _tos.length multiplication.

The total local variable is subtracted from the caller balance.
batchSend performs the unchecked balance decrement.
balanceOf is the mapping mutated by the unchecked batch decrement.
The loop counter i drives the batchSend distribution loop.
The per-iteration _to local variable receives balances and emits transfers.
setTradeAddress reads the addr parameter.

pairFor reads the factory parameter.
pairFor reads tokenA.
pairFor reads tokenB.

token1 is used in the pair hash computation.

The constructor reads its _symbol parameter.
The constructor reads its _supply parameter.
The constructor sets owner = msg.sender, permanently binding privilege to the untrusted deployer identity.
The constructor performs the unchecked supply scaling multiplication.

decimals is the exponent of the unchecked supply computation.
The constructor writes the owner state variable.
The constructor writes the name state variable.
